title: Check in the PyTorch label list used by the TESTOWNERS lint
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #192829

The TESTOWNERS linter fetched the set of valid labels from
https://ossci-metrics.s3.amazonaws.com/pytorch_labels.json at import time, so
lint results depended on two things outside the commit under test: network
reachability, and the current mutable label set on GitHub. Deleting a label
upstream retroactively breaks lint on every test file that names it, as just
happened with "oncall: package/deploy" (a header that had been valid and
unchanged for years). Lint should be a function of the checked-out tree.

The label set is now a snapshot at tools/linter/adapters/pytorch_labels.json,
read from disk. The alternative of keeping the fetch but downgrading unknown
labels to a warning was rejected: it keeps the nondeterminism and just makes it
quieter. Refreshing the snapshot is a deliberate, reviewable commit, which is
also where you would notice a label being renamed out from under a test file.

Regeneration reuses the existing exporter rather than a new script:
export_pytorch_labels.py gains --output-file, which writes the same list it
would otherwise upload to S3 (the boto3 import moved into the S3 branch so the
local path does not need it). The S3 upload workflow is left alone; nothing in
this repo reads that object anymore, but it costs nothing to keep publishing.

The new JSON is excluded from CODESPELL because the real label
"ci: sev-infra.thirdparty" trips the "thirdparty ==> third party" rule.

Test Plan:

Regenerated the snapshot and confirmed the linter is clean over every file
lintrunner matches for TESTOWNERS (1286 files, no messages), including
test/package/test_save_load.py from the original failure:

```
GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) python3 .github/scripts/export_pytorch_labels.py \
    pytorch pytorch --output-file tools/linter/adapters/pytorch_labels.json

python3 -c "
import subprocess, glob
files = [f for f in glob.glob('test/**/test_*.py', recursive=True)
              + glob.glob('test/**/*_test.py', recursive=True)
         if '/fb/' not in f and f != 'test/run_test.py']
out = subprocess.run(['python3', 'tools/linter/adapters/testowners_linter.py', '--'] + files,
                     capture_output=True, text=True)
print(len(files), out.stdout or 'NO LINT MESSAGES')"
```

Confirmed an unknown label is still an error:

```
printf '# Owner(s): ["oncall: bogus-label-xyz"]\n' > /tmp/test_bogus.py
python3 tools/linter/adapters/testowners_linter.py -- /tmp/test_bogus.py
```

```
lintrunner .github/scripts/export_pytorch_labels.py .lintrunner.toml \
    tools/linter/adapters/pytorch_labels.json tools/linter/adapters/testowners_linter.py
```

Authored with the assistance of Claude Code.
